settings.title: Settings
settings.daemon_down_desc: The first start downloads the signature database (about 300 MB) and can take several minutes. Check the service log if this persists.
settings.listen_lan: LAN access (open TCP 3310 in the node firewall)
settings.endpoints_title: Where clients reach this scanner (mode: daemon / host, port 3310)
settings.ep_same_node_slirp: Module on this node with slirp4netns network (Nextcloud):
settings.ep_same_node_pasta: Module on this node with pasta network:
settings.ep_hint: Loopback and the cluster VPN are always allowed; the LAN address only with LAN access enabled.
settings.max_file_size_mb_helper: Larger files are not scanned (clamd MaxFileSize).
settings.max_scan_size_mb_helper: Data scanned per file including unpacked archives (clamd MaxScanSize).
settings.stream_max_length_mb_helper: Largest file a client may stream to the daemon (clamd StreamMaxLength). Not smaller than the maximum file size; set the same value in the client (Nextcloud: 'maximum stream length' in bytes).
settings.signature_checks_per_day_helper: freshclam checks database.clamav.net this many times per day.
settings.nextcloud_hint_desc: Install the app 'Antivirus for files', choose mode 'Daemon (host)' and enter the values below – the address only in the 'Host' field, the port in its own 'Port' field.
settings.port_3310_in_use: TCP 3310 is already in use on this node (another ClamAV instance?)
settings.size_out_of_range: Enter a value between 1 and 4000 MB
settings.stream_smaller_than_file: The stream length must not be smaller than the maximum file size
settings.web_host_helper: Publishes an upload form and a REST API through Traefik with TLS. Empty = web front end off.
settings.web_auth_off_allowlist: Everyone in the allowed client networks can use the upload form and the REST API without a password.
settings.web_auth_off_open: No allowed client networks are set: anyone who reaches this host name can use the scanner without a password. Restrict the networks below.
settings.web_auth_ldap: Users of a user domain (LDAP / Active Directory)
settings.ldap_group_helper: Only members of this group may log in (nested groups count). Empty: every user of the domain.
settings.ldap_domain_unknown: This user domain does not exist in the cluster
settings.web_password_helper: At least 8 characters. For the login page and the REST API (HTTP basic authentication).
settings.secret_is_set: A password is stored — leave blank to keep it.
settings.ip_allowlist_helper: CIDR networks allowed to reach the web front end; empty allows all.
settings.web_api_hint: POST /api/v1/scan (multipart field 'file', several allowed) returns JSON per file: clean / infected + signature / error. GET /api/v1/version, GET /api/v1/health (no login).
settings.web_password_required: Password required to enable the web front end
settings.domain_already_used_in_traefik: This host name is already used by another instance.
settings.nextcloud_none: No Nextcloud is installed in the cluster. Same node: 10.0.2.2, other node: the VPN address above.
